name: Nearby Chests
author: Glutoblop
description: Adds a Nearby chests panel to your inventory listing everything in chests within 30m, and lets you take items, or a selected recipe's missing ingredients, straight into your inventory.

changelog.0.1.6: The x1, x5, and x10 buttons now gather ingredients for that many crafts, including recipes that yield multiple items per craft.
changelog.0.1.5: Move the x1, x5, and x10 ingredient grab buttons below Filter chests.
changelog.0.1.4: Add x1, x5, and x10 ingredient grabs above Filter chests, with chest stock and inventory slot checks.
changelog.0.1.3: Mod Settings button in the pause menu: change this plugin's settings in game (one tab per plugin).
changelog.0.1.2: Nearby tab lists unlocked build pieces (Hammer/Hoe/Cultivator) with their ingredients; Chests panel sits just left of the crafting panel and below pop-up dialogs (split stack); Drag the chests panel by its title bar to move it; right-click to reset; Left-align the chests panel title with padding
changelog.0.1.1: Nearby tab: every unlocked recipe in the crafting list (makeable ones highlighted), chests panel under your inventory with search, drag/split/ctrl-click to take or store, Filter chests button and need/have/in-chests amounts.
changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: Nearby chests panel (30m), click to take items, click recipe ingredients or 'Take recipe' to pull missing materials.
